Coordinator now records model_output_limited in the current SDK-turn after_model callback before SDK event filtering, resets it per turn, and checks it after joined-turn cleanup/before budget mapping. All three MAX_TOKENS role cases pass on the hashed sources.

annotation_boundaries.production_int_shapes: The inventoried domain callables use plain int and findings Optional[int]. No Annotated[int] or list[int] callable parameter exists in these listed families.
annotation_boundaries.list_runner_cases: Four original test_runner_preserves_raw_integer_list_rejection cases execute list[int] validation through the real Runtime Runner.
annotation_boundaries.annotated_callable_unit_cases: runtime/tests/test_worker_function_tools.py::test_function_tool_keeps_raw_numbers_and_native_structured_conversion covers Annotated/Optional/list and function/method/instance/partial mechanics; these unit cases are outside the 42-case command and do not substitute for the production-family Runner probes.
annotation_boundaries.intentional_numeric_unions: HTTP request timeout:int|float|None and Caido timeout_seconds:int|float intentionally accept fractions. They are excluded from strict-int rejection. The production adapter leaves multi-numeric unions to SDK processing, which does not apply its single-int coercion to such unions.
annotation_boundaries.unknown_field_policy: Owner raw guards remain on Memory/taint/exec. The migration adds no blanket unknown-field rejection or coercion policy to unrelated tools.

mutation_control.description: An isolated pytest.MonkeyPatch restores the stock SDK preprocessing method only in the child interpreter, replacing ContractorFunctionTool._preprocess_args with FunctionTool._preprocess_args. No repository or installed dependency file changes.
mutation_control.command:
cd runtime && PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src:tests .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import pytest
from google.adk.tools import FunctionTool
from contractor_runtime.worker.function_tools import ContractorFunctionTool
with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
    patch.setattr(ContractorFunctionTool, '_preprocess_args', FunctionTool._preprocess_args)
    code = pytest.main(['-q', '--tb=line', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-W', 'error', 'tests/test_adk_migration_contracts.py', '-k', 'production_numeric_sibling'])
raise SystemExit(code)
PY
mutation_control.plugin_autoload: Disabled only for this mutation process because preloading the SDK before pytest initializes otherwise causes an anyio assertion-rewrite warning. The normal 42-case run uses normal plugin loading and -W error.
mutation_control.interpretation: The six coercible production representatives detect the missing adapter. Valid null remains valid; taint/exec remain protected by their earlier raw-admission guards, which run before SDK preprocessing.

limits_of_evidence: This file records only the 42-case component run and its isolated nine-case negative mutation control.
Production sibling inference is named separately from exact Runner dispatch; per-field permutations are not claimed as new Runner tests.
Full Runtime/Linux suites, clean dependency installation, cross-language checks and lint are separate task gates owned by the coordinator.
